answer: Bonded escrows make each identity accountable, while evidence of coordinated equivocation triggers pairwise penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²), across k linked identities. An exponential detection multiplier further raises the swarm’s total capital loss, so splitting stake among sybils does not dilute risk. Correlation analysis must distinguish genuine coordination from unrelated validators; harbor, glacier, and ferrous may label test identities, not proof of collusion.
